bio: A former El Paso clinic nurse, she keeps a paper map of every border county in her desk.

name: Tessa McRae

name: Brock Hensley
bio: Hensley is a Cody rancher who served two Army tours and still repairs his own fence.
tell: He supports gun rights and a larger defense budget without compromise.
